China's Factory-Gate Inflation Surges Amid Rising Commodity Costs

China's factory-gate inflation accelerated, reaching its fastest pace since June 2022, driven by rising commodity costs, particularly oil. While producer prices saw a significant increase, consumer inflation (CPI) lagged behind forecasts. This trend is viewed as another warning sign for China's economy, with some reports also noting subdued consumer credit.
